sourceCard: CardData/Item/hw_spirit_goat.json (+ goat spirit events, blueprints, liquid)
subject: the Goat Spirit drawn the way vanilla draws an animal spirit (Moontouched; vanilla animal spirit calling cards draw the plain wild animal): a natural wild goat standing calmly on a mossy rock in a green pine forest, its whole body painted in pale green-gold; no mist, glow or swirls; pair with hw_spirit_lynx
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 is how vanilla Card Survival draws an animal SPIRIT: an ordinary, natural-looking animal standing calmly in a green forest, with its whole body painted in one pale unnatural spirit colour (there pale ice blue) using flat colour fills and thin dark ink outlines. Match that treatment and composition exactly, but draw a different animal in a different spirit colour. Reference image 2 is a second style reference: match its flat posterized fills, thin ink outlines and muted forest greens; do not copy its wolf.
Draw: the Goat Spirit. A wild mountain goat standing on all four legs on a mossy rock in a green pine forest, facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle, head level, calm. Long ridged horns curving back over its neck, a short pointed beard, a sturdy body, cloven hooves. Its whole body, horns and beard are painted in pale green-gold tones (pale sage green with soft gold, three or four flat tonal steps), the way reference image 1 paints its wolf pale blue. A natural solid animal, not made of mist. The goat fills about the middle half of the frame, its body in the lower middle; dark trunks and green undergrowth behind it as in the references.
Style: plain vanilla Card Survival game art: a full-bleed painted forest scene reaching every edge of the frame, flat colour fills in a few tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines, muted natural colours. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: mist, smoke, wisps, glow, sparkles, swirls, aura, magic particles, transparent ghost, glowing eyes, rearing, dramatic pose, dramatic lighting, rim light, ornate patterns, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, cartoon, comic book, anime, cute, glossy highlights, neon colours, lens flare, multiple animals, cropped, blurry, plain white background, vignette, white border, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, footprints, tracks, prints in the ground.
